title: Dad and me
caption: I used to watch the road from behind his shoulder. He never seemed to be in a hurry.

title: Packed for the road
caption: Raincoat, toolkit, charger. The laptop came too. One night in Karawang first.

title: A place out of the rain
caption: Sari made room for my bag under the roof. A cup of tea, and time to let the rain pass.
